7.4.2.6.1 UDS DID
[SWS_Dcm_00578] ⌈On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), for every requested DID outside the OBD range (F400-F8FF), after all verification (see [SWS_Dcm_00433], [SWS_Dcm_00434] and [SWS_Dcm_00435]), If the Manager data is configured as a "ECU signal" of the IoHwAb (parameter DcmDspDataUsePort), the Dcm shall call the Api IoHwAb_Dcm_Read<EcuSignalName >() (parameter DcmDspDataReadEcuSignal) to get the Data. In this case, the requirements
[SWS_Dcm_00439], [SWS_Dcm_00436] and [SWS_Dcm_00437] shall not apply.⌋
